name: draw_on_screen
description: Draw on the student's screen (or the lecture slide) over regions returned by the latest analyze_current_screen: circle, underline, box, arrow, highlight or point, with short labels and labelled arrows between regions. Animated like hand drawing. Use it while you explain. Never invent regionIds.

regionId.description: A regionId returned by the latest analyze_current_screen.

label.description: Optional few-word label, up to 60 characters.

connections.description: Up to 6 labelled arrows between two regions.

from.description: A regionId returned by the latest analyze_current_screen.

to.description: A regionId returned by the latest analyze_current_screen.

clear.description: true replaces your previous drawing; false adds to it.
